jobs.description:
**Technical Lead/Solutions Architect**

**Job Description Summary**

The Technical Lead / Solution Architect will provide technical leadership, solution architecture, and engineering direction for a large\-scale agile software development and platform modernization program supporting a federal contract. This role is responsible for defining and guiding the modernization approach, including target\-state architecture, integration patterns, API\-enabled services, shared platform capabilities, technical standards, legacy coexistence, and incremental transition planning. The Technical Lead / Solution Architect will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, engineering teams, enterprise architects, vendors, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to ensure modernization outcomes are scalable, secure, maintainable, interoperable, and aligned to program objectives.

**What You Will Do****:**

We are seeking a strong Technical Lead / Solution Architect to guide solution design and technical execution for a large\-scale platform modernization effort. This role will shape the technical vision, lead architecture and engineering decisions, and coordinate implementation across multiple workstreams, vendors, and Scrum teams while supporting continuity of the legacy system throughout the transition.

The Technical Lead / Solution Architect will own technical solution alignment, architecture decisions, implementation guidance, interface coordination, modernization trade\-off analysis, and engineering standards in an iterative modernization environment. This individual will guide delivery of a modern integration layer that enables new vendor\-delivered capabilities to interface with legacy components as the modernized platform is built out over time. jobs.title: Software Engineering & AI Intern
jobs.description:
**Description**


Leidos, a leading defense, intelligence, and technology company, is seeking motivated and aspiring software engineering students for our Summer 2027 Internship Program (Starts May 2027\). As a Software Engineering \& AI Intern, you will join our Digital Sector on the Global Solutions Management – Operations II (GSM\-O II) contract. This contract includes the Operations, Sustainment, Maintenance, Repair, and Defense of the Defense Information System Network (DISN) in support of the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA). This role is primarily remote, with mandatory, periodic on\-site requirements at either Scott AFB, IL or Ft. Meade, MD.


Your Opportunity:


We are looking for highly motivated, driven, and capable candidates to join our GSM\-O Global Automation and Intelligent Network Solutions (GAINS) Team! This summer, you will do more than observe—you will help build intelligent systems that operate at mission\-critical scale. You will work with high\-volume data, engineer real\-time pipelines using technologies such as Kafka and Elastic, and apply predictive machine learning and generative AI to detect emerging problems and advance toward closed\-loop, self\-healing networks. You will gain hands\-on experience with AWS, Databricks, Watson AIOps and cybersecurity automation, building the technical experience and portfolio\-ready accomplishments that can accelerate your career.


What You’ll Do (Potential Projects \& Learning Opportunities):

* Design, develop, document, test, and deploy software written in Python, JavaScript, Java, and SQL.
* Create Kibana visualizations and dashboards to provide information to users and support staff.
* Develop Kafka system integrations between Elasticsearch/Logstash and other systems, such as Databricks.
* Develop and apply AI/ML and automation capabilities.
* Assist with the deployment, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, maintenance, updates/upgrades of Kafka and Elastic clusters and environments.
